title: Output of a Citebase one-shot run
description: One dataset item per run with tool, ok, result and error. Public tools also save their answer in OUTPUT. An encrypted private request returns only the store_id and key of its restricted result in OUTPUT and the dataset. The signed-in server returns results directly.

results.title: Tool result
results.description: The run's result as a dataset item: tool, ok, result, error.

output.title: OUTPUT record
output.description: The tool's result object on its own, as JSON. Missing when the run failed.
